name: Extractor Shampoo

features.text: Effectively cleans carpet, upholstery, vinyl, leather, and plastic.
Cleans heavily soiled surfaces with ease.

description: A concentrated shampoo used in extractor machines for general carpet and upholstery cleaning. Can also be used as a pre-spot treatment.
application: DIRECTIONS: AS WITH ANY CLEANER, TEST PRODUCT ON AN INCONSPICUOUS AREA FOR COMPATIBILITY. EXTRACTOR MACHINE: 1) Dilute 1 part product with 10 to 30 parts water. 2) Use mixture according to extractor-machine directions. 3) After extraction process, wipe cleaned areas with a dry, clean towel to remove excess moisture. GENERAL CLEANING: 1) Dilute 1 part product with 6 to 9 parts water. 2) Spray or wipe on soiled surface. 3) Allow product to penetrate approximately 2-3 minutes. Agitation with a brush may be needed for heavily soiled areas. 4) Wipe surface with a dry, clean towel to remove any residue. PRE-TREAT: 1) Dilute 1 part product with 6 parts water. 2) Spray on soiled surface. 3) Allow product to penetrate approximately 5-10 minutes. Agitation with a brush may be needed for heavily soiled areas.
